note: Helena-Lewis and Clark NF campground near the top of Kings Hill Pass on US 89 in the Little Belt Mountains, the highest developed campground in the range (~8,000 ft). Porphyry Peak fire lookout nearby. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 18 sites, 35-ft largest trailer slot, vault toilets and potable water, $15/night (fees already human-checked). Added season (opens mid-late June, closes around end of September; closed for winter 2026). Not stated: hookups (derived none left), reservations/FCFS (derived FCFS left; no campground listing on recreation.gov). Note trimmed of restated values.
